candidates.name: Atlas Flow
candidates.summary: An AI workspace that shows research, filtering and synthesis as observable task stages.

evidence.title: Atlas Flow product overview
evidence.excerpt: Atlas Flow displays the research plan, visited sources and intermediate findings before composing the final result. Users can pause the workflow and revise the research direction.

evidence.title: Atlas Flow release notes
evidence.excerpt: The latest release adds checkpoints for source review and lets users restart a failed stage without rerunning the complete task.
